transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We've got a situation to deal with — the outbound conveyor to the finished-goods warehouse is stopped, and we have 900 finished cartons staged for dispatch that need somewhere to go. The good news is that Warehouse Zone C and the adjacent Zone D are currently clear of production materials, so we have temporary staging space available. I need to make a decision on the temporary storage arrangement and dispatch controls, but before I authorize a temporary staging plan, I want to make sure we go through our normal warehouse review process — maintenance, environmental health and safety, and logistics. Can I get input from each of those areas so we can get this moving safely and efficiently?
